title: Real local OCR runner profile

context.summary: Add a supported local OCR runner and wire PDF/image OCR through it.
context.background: The v0.1.1 target requires OCR to be a checked supported local path rather than only an adapter contract.

in: Add a real local OCR runner profile based on PaddleOCR or another maintained OCR service.
Add Compose service, healthcheck, resource hints, installer auto-install wiring and logs.
Route PDF and image OCR through @mindory/llm with source refs and artifact persistence.
Add live PDF and image OCR acceptance coverage.
out: ASR, vision, face or generation runners.

acceptance_criteria: Installer can select, start and healthcheck the OCR runner.
Scanned PDF and image OCR produce text spans, artifacts, source refs and searchable content.
Failure diagnostics identify runner startup, healthcheck and OCR operation errors.

manual_checks: Run the OCR live profile on a Docker-capable machine.
Inspect OCR artifacts for page/image source refs.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
